name: Travis Landing
title: Travis Landing Window Cleaning, Lake Travis | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in Travis Landing inside Hudson Bend. Homes from 1,460 to 3,160 sq ft, pure water, about $10 per window. Quotes by text.
intro: Travis Landing is a lakeside subdivision inside Hudson Bend, with several hundred homes in a wide mix of sizes and ages. CleanzATX cleans windows here for owners who want it done properly at a fair, published price.

sections.h2: What Travis Landing homes are like
paragraphs: This is one of the more approachable parts of the lake. Several hundred homes sit on the banks of Lake Travis inside the Hudson Bend peninsula, with sizes from about 1,460 to 3,160 sq ft and prices from $435K to $925K. There is no gate, and the row of houses shows a lot of variety: some original, some renovated, some rebuilt.

Families here are zoned to Lake Travis Elementary and Hudson Bend Middle School, so you see plenty of bikes, boat trailers and swing sets in front yards. People keep up their homes, but they are busy, and window cleaning is the kind of chore that gets pushed back.

sections.h2: What Travis Landing windows deal with
paragraphs: Homes close to the water pick up hard water mist, and homes farther back get sprinkler spray on the lower panes. Both leave white mineral spots that a regular glass cleaner just smears around. We remove them at $10 per pane with pure water and the proper tools, which is far easier before they have baked on for years.

Mixed lot sizes mean mixed trees. Where oaks and cedars shade the house, screens and tracks collect pollen, webs and leaf bits. Cedar pollen runs from December to February, and live oak pollen follows in March and April. Cleaning screens at $5 each and tracks at $5 makes a real difference to how the windows open and look.

Without gates, scheduling is simple. We park on the street or driveway, run the pure water system from the truck and use water fed poles to clean exterior glass from the ground, up to three stories. Because homes here are mostly one and two story, most jobs go quickly. When neighbors book near each other, we can often schedule back to back, which helps keep the route tight and the visit efficient.
For a 2,200 sq ft home, exterior windows are about $220 at $0.10 per sq ft, though the minimum job is $200. Time on site is roughly one and a half to two hours for the outside.

faq.q: Is my small home under your minimum?
faq.a: Our minimum job is $200. A home near 1,460 sq ft would come to about $146 at $0.10 per sq ft, so the minimum would apply. Adding screens, tracks or inside cleaning brings you past it.

faq.q: Will the white spots on my windows come off?
faq.a: Often yes, especially if they are fresh. Spot removal is $10 per pane. If a spot has etched into the glass we tell you honestly what to expect before we start.

faq.q: Can you do inside and outside in one visit?
faq.a: Yes. Inside and out is $15 per window. Interior glass is cleaned by hand with squeegees, and we lay drop cloths so floors and furniture stay clean. We bring the pure water and the tools, so you only need to leave the gates unlocked.

faq.q: Do you clean gutters in Travis Landing?
faq.a: Yes. Gutters are $1.50 per linear foot for one story, $2.25 for two and $3.25 for three. Many owners add them to a window visit so we only have to come once.

faq.q: What if it rains after you clean?
faq.a: Plans with Triannual, Quarterly or Every 2 Months include a 7 day rain guarantee. On every job, text a photo within 7 days and, when we are in the area, we come back and touch it up for free.
